primary_component.label: H4A liquidity sweep/rejection predicts signed 30-minute reversal return
primary_component.trigger_time: close of the qualifying first-contact five-minute bar
primary_component.endpoint_rule: close of the five-minute bar exactly 6 five-minute bars after the trigger bar (30 clock minutes after trigger-bar end)
primary_component.interpretation: positive signed return means price moved in the preregistered sweep/rejection direction
primary_component.estimand: mean signed_forward_return_30m across eligible trigger events
primary_component.support_rule: SUPPORTED only if two-sided p < 0.05 and estimated mean signed return > 0; CONTRADICTED only if two-sided p < 0.05 and estimated mean signed return < 0; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED

primary_inference.reference_df: number of unique eligible session_date clusters - 1
primary_inference.reason: multiple qualifying merged-zone events may occur within one trading session; session clustering prevents treating same-day event returns as independent

secondary_descriptive_outcomes.mfe_30m: maximum favorable signed price excursion over bars t+1 through t+6 relative to trigger_close
secondary_descriptive_outcomes.mae_30m: maximum adverse signed price excursion over bars t+1 through t+6 relative to trigger_close
secondary_descriptive_outcomes.family_status: descriptive/robustness only; not part of H4A primary support decision

prespecified_robustness.session_collapsed: average signed 30-minute return within each eligible session, then test mean session return with Newey-West HAC lag 5
prespecified_robustness.year_by_year: report annual event counts and annual mean signed 30-minute returns
prespecified_robustness.confluence_split: report confluence versus single-source as descriptive stability
prespecified_robustness.rvol_split: report elevated versus non-elevated RVOL descriptively
prespecified_robustness.rule: robustness cannot upgrade a failed H4A primary result to SUPPORTED

economic_reporting.gross_or_net: gross price return before spread, slippage, commissions, or market impact
economic_reporting.strategy_claim: no deployable trading-strategy claim is permitted from the gross signal test alone; execution-cost analysis is required separately

multiple_testing.adjustment: none required for single frozen H4A primary test
multiple_testing.secondary_horizons: not allowed to replace or upgrade primary decision
